response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/backend engineer with deep expertise in web technologies, DLang, Node.js, and TypeScript, but he lacks the core requirement of substantial hands-on C++ development (his only C++ exposure was brief work at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a bachelor's thesis project), has no Windows platform development experience, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience beyond a brief stint at a German investment startup using Node/TypeScript.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years)
Strong background in testing, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months, over a decade ago) far short of required 5-10 years
No Windows platform development experience evident anywhere in career
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise; RIDE Capital role used Node/TypeScript, not C++

key_factors.factor: No Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle experience
No fixed income/capital markets domain expertise
